result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers correctly name the cut-off axis as the main problem and make it concrete: 20 vs 150 units, so the last bar looks about 7.5 times taller, against a real rise of +2.7%. Both recommend zero-based bars, labels on each bar, an honest title and flat styling. A explains the zero-baseline and line-chart options more clearly; B adds useful context (whether resolutions are keeping up with ticket volume, and whether Q4 is incomplete) but states its reason for the zero-baseline fix only briefly within the fix itself. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers name the truncated axis as the main problem and make the 7.5x-versus-2.7% gap concrete. Both recommend zero-based bars or a labeled line chart, data labels and an honest title. B explains the fix more clearly: at zero the bars look nearly equal, the quarterly changes are +41, +44 and +45, and the subtitle and line-chart advice are concrete. A adds a useful point about the missing denominator, but its claim that Q4 might be partial because of today's date is a guess the request gives no basis for.
